en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate three‑storey building with a flag flying from the roof, set in an open field with a dirt path and telephone pole in the foreground. Smaller outbuildings and additional houses stand to the left and right. A few people are visible near the main entrance and on the path. The caption beneath the image reads "Posthuset, Tierp".
